title: Caravel Trade
summary: README-only concept for a non-custodial private order book for Ootle testnet. The October 14 README describes TARI versus Caravel Test Dollar (cUSD), a testnet placeholder, and a 1% trade fee split between Caravel and the burn wallet. The repository currently contains a README, MIT license and ignore file; implementation is not present in the reviewed default branch. The reviewed repository supplied no homepage or release. No separate public sharing announcement was found; discovered in the creator’s repository inventory.
